roleDescriptions.admin: Full access, including the team and company settings.
roleDescriptions.fleet_manager: Manages vehicles, documents, maintenance and expenses.
roleDescriptions.mechanic: Handles maintenance and damage reports; read-only elsewhere.
roleDescriptions.driver: Sees the fleet and can report damage.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a team member
inviteDialog.description: They'll get a link to create an account in your company. The link is valid for 7 days.
inviteDialog.emailedDescription: We emailed an invitation to {email}. You can also share the link below.
inviteDialog.notEmailedDescription: Email sending isn't configured, so nothing was sent. Share this link with {email} yourself.

members.removeDescription: Their account is deleted and they lose access immediately. Vehicles, maintenance and expenses they created stay in the company.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.
invitations.newLink: New link created for {email} — the old one no longer works. Copy it from the list.
invitations.revokeDescription: The invite link stops working. You can invite them again later.

errors.notAllowed: Only admins can manage the team.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of your company.
errors.ownRole: You can't change your own role.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

email.subject: You're invited to join {company} on FleetCore
email.body:
{inviter} invited you to join {company} on FleetCore as {role}.

Create your account here:
{url}

This link expires in {days} days.

invite.title: Join {company}
invite.description: You've been invited as {role}. Create your account to get started.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

errors.rejected: This invitation can't be used anymore. Ask your admin for a new one.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Invitations only work for new accounts.

invalid.title: Invitation not found
invalid.description: This link is invalid or the invitation was revoked. Ask your admin for a new one.

accepted.title: Invitation already used
accepted.description: An account was already created with this invitation. Log in to continue.

expired.title: Invitation expired
expired.description: Ask an admin of {company} to send you a new invitation.

signedIn.title: You're already signed in
signedIn.description: You're signed in as {currentEmail}. This invitation is for {email} — sign out to create that account.
